svg.text: Rear-loader garbage truck · Gil Mott — contestant vehicle dossier
“Truck’s loud. You learn not to listen close. That was the whole job.”
Rear-loader hopper — never quite stops grinding
Missing-person flyer taped in the cab
He heard a sound. He didn’t stop.
A municipal rear-loader garbage truck, filthy
gray-green grimy paint, a dented rear compactor
hopper leaking ooze, the city seal scrubbed half
off, an amber beacon, rust and industrial wear,
Realistic · Symmetry On · Quad · ~55k tris · PBR 4K
